role: Post-open solver-native anchor-identifiability audit on already opened BLASTNet Case 19. It does not run a full traversal or train a model.
scientific_question: Does one zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS iteration provide a deployment-visible residual-contraction signal that selects a robustly K16-safe anchor in every Case 19 rig, when two cheaper observation-only controls do not?

unique_primary.name: minimum_zero_start_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k1_residual_contraction
unique_primary.score: For each frame run exactly one zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS iteration and compute norm(r1)/norm(y). Select the minimum score.
unique_primary.tie_break: Lexicographic tuple (score, canonical observation L2 norm, SHA-256 of canonical little-endian float64 observation bytes). Frame index, time, rig identity and truth are forbidden.
unique_primary.camera_permutation: Reported camera IDs restore blocks to canonical ID order for tie data; jointly permuted observations and geometry must preserve scores and selected physical frame.
unique_primary.frame_permutation: Permuting the frame set must preserve the selected physical frame.

admissible_controls.cosine_medoid: Scale-invariant canonical-observation cosine medoid using order-stable row sums and the same norm/digest tie convention; 0A+0A^T.
admissible_controls.minimum_observation_norm: Minimum canonical observation L2 norm with digest tie break; 0A+0A^T.

disclosed_nonadmissible_diagnostic.reason_not_a_blocker: Uses sequence index and therefore is not frame-set permutation equivariant or observation/geometry-only.

robust_label_contract.label: A frame is safe only if the componentwise maximum of the sealed v244.2 formal and independent K16 metric vectors passes every strict limit.

prediction_barrier.inputs_before_barrier: Only sealed observations, reported virtual geometry and frozen PCGLS constants.

decision_order: Any invalid source, parent, barrier, call, permutation or independent numerical check gives INCONCLUSIVE.
If the primary does not select a robustly safe anchor in all 13 rigs, close the K1 residual-contraction anchor hypothesis.
If the primary is 13/13 but either admissible zero-call control is also 13/13, report that anchor safety is not isolated and do not authorize a full mechanism.
Only primary 13/13 with both admissible controls below 13/13 authorizes a separately preregistered full solver-state traversal audit.
The midpoint diagnostic is always disclosed but cannot block the admissible comparison.
failure_action: Close this K1 contraction anchor hypothesis without changing the score, tie break, threshold, PCGLS depth or controls; do not train a larger model or rent a GPU.
